tagline: Front desk and follow-up for clinics

plans.name: Reminders
items: Confirmation and reminder for every visit
Patients confirm or change the time by replying
A new time offered after a missed visit

plans.name: Front Desk
items: Receptionist on your phone line and WhatsApp, day and night
Books, moves and cancels visits in your diary
A note for you when a caller needs a person

plans.name: Complete
plans.for: The whole follow-up, off your desk
items: Follow-ups for the review visits you advise
A check on the patient the day after a procedure
Changes to the wording within a day
A call with us every month

sprint.name: Pilot clinics
sprint.text: We are setting this up with a small number of clinics in each city first. A pilot runs for two weeks on one doctor's diary, and you decide after seeing the morning sheets.

terms: Terms and price are agreed with each clinic in writing before anything goes live.
channels: Calls are answered on your clinic's own number. Messages go from your clinic's own WhatsApp Business number or e-mail, only to patients who agreed to them.
